name: Proofmark
summary: A task and project desk for a small book publisher with six titles moving through production
about: A complete task and project app for a small team, shown with a made-up publishing house and six titles in production, from manuscript to print. Each book has its stages, tasks, files and notes, a drawn cover and a spine on the shelf that fills as it moves along. Good for publishers, magazines, content studios and any team that ships a few big pieces through fixed stages.
how: Desk shows the shelf: spines slide in, their height is the page count and the light band shows progress. Click a spine to open the book.
Titles lists the season with covers and stage bars. A book's drawer has its stages, tasks, files and notes, and a Next stage button.
Production is a grid of titles against stages. Click any cell to finish that stage, reopen it or add a task there.
On Schedule, drag the right edge of a stage to stretch it and every later stage, including publication, moves with it. Arrow keys do the same.
Tasks lists everything with filters for mine, overdue, this week and done. Tick to finish, open a task to add subtasks and comments.
People, Reports and Settings cover the team and freelancers, throughput charts, the paper or ink theme and Reset demo data.
